greeting: Metal barrels. None of that wooden garbage.
Mike's Metal. If it doesn't clang, it's wrong.
What? Yeah, I sell barrels. Metal ones. The superior kind.
Heard Bob sent you? Figures. Can't handle real containment.
Need something that won't rot? You've come to the right place.
Got scrap barrels, drum barrels, and my specialty - mystery barrels. Contents unknown.
Buy a barrel or don't. I'm not desperate. ...Okay, maybe a little.
dialog.shop_open: These ain't pretty, but they work. Fireproof, waterproof, and unlike Bob's junk, they don't get termites.
dialog.shop_prompt: Metal containers. Industrial grade. Surplus from the Deep Dig operation.
haggle: Price is price. Metal costs what metal costs.
Fine. Ten percent off. But you didn't get it from me.
I'll match Bob's price, but you tell everyone mine are better.
For you? Because you look like you appreciate quality.
purchase_success: There's a dent on that one. Makes it unique. Don't complain.
Comes with complimentary rust removal tip: don't let it rust.
Sold. Try not to store anything alive in there. Learned that the hard way.
rumor: Bob's 'premium oak' comes from the same place as his personality - rotten.
Deep-Dig Dan found something metal in the eastern shaft. Won't let me see it. Suspicious.
That barrelgob living in the junkyard? Used to be a customer. Took 'living in a barrel' too literally.
Signguy down the road owes me money. Painted my sign wrong on purpose. 'Metal Barels.' Idiot.
dialog.quest_hook: Look, I'm not saying Bob's got it out for me, but someone keeps stealing my best scrap barrels. Leaves wooden ones in their place. Message? Find who's doing it and I'll pay.
dialog.quest_active: Any leads on my barrel thief? Check the junkyard. Nothing's stolen, just... replaced. It's psychological warfare.
dialog.quest_complete: So it was that little barrelgob gremlin? Trading up from wooden to metal? Can't blame him. Here's your cut.
farewell: Don't scratch 'em on the way out.
Tell Bob his barrels are still inferior.
Come back. Not that I care.
ambient_barks: Fireproof containers! For your fireproof needs!
Who needs aesthetics? Function over form!
Bob's barrels are kindling waiting to happen!
dialog.time_noon: Hot. Metal gets hot. Don't touch. Obviously.
dialog.time_dusk: Day's ending. Sales weren't great. Thanks for noticing.
dialog.time_night: Night's when the weird customers come. Present company excluded. Maybe.
dialog.rival_mention: Bob says wood 'breathes.' Yeah, it breathes rot and failure.
dialog.post_quest_greeting: The detective. Find any other thieves while you're at it?

party_reactions.nix7: Metal superior to organic wood. This merchant is logical.
party_reactions.twist: Can I roll down a hill in one?
party_reactions.renna: Do you two ever... not compete? No?

relationship_dialog.stranger: First time? Don't touch what you can't afford.
relationship_dialog.acquaintance: Back again. You have taste, I'll give you that.
relationship_dialog.friend: For you, I saved the good stuff. The really good stuff.
relationship_dialog.best_friend: Listen, I'm opening a franchise in the Obsidian Reach. Interested in investing?

mini_quest.title: The Barrel Swapper
mini_quest.description: Find who's been replacing Mike's metal barrels with wooden ones

stages.hook: Someone keeps stealing my metal barrels and leaving wooden garbage behind. It's personal. Find them.
stages.active: Check the junkyard. Barrelgob territory. Little thieves love shiny things.
stages.complete: Barrelgob trading up, huh? Can't blame him. Metal IS better. Here's a prototype - experimental alloy. Don't ask where I got it.
